key_idea: Follow each strip from one end to the other and think about how long its pieces are.
steps: The 1 is just one short piece. The 7 has only 2 pieces.
The 3 has more pieces, but they are all short.
The 2 is wider and taller than the 3. Its 3 flat pieces are much longer than the flat pieces of the 3.
So the strip of the 2 is the longest.

choice_feedback.A: The 1 is just one short piece. It is the shortest strip of all.
choice_feedback.C: The pieces of the 3 are short. The 2 is wider and taller, so its strip is longer.
choice_feedback.D: The 7 has only 2 pieces. The strip of the 2 is much longer.
choice_feedback.E: The strips are not the same. The 1 is much shorter than the 2.
